input.command: cd /workspace/inventory && ls -la && git status && git log --oneline -10

cd /workspace/inventory && cat src/inventory/pricing.py && echo "=== TEST ===" && cat tests/test_pricing.py && echo "=== CHANGELOG ===" && cat CHANGELOG.md && echo "=== TODO ===" && cat TODO.md && echo "=== README ===" && cat README.md && echo "=== pyproject ===" && cat pyproject.toml
cd /workspace/inventory && find .gnomon -type f | head -50 && echo "=== CONTENTS ===" && for f in $(find .gnomon -type f); do echo "----- $f -----"; cat "$f"; echo; done

cd /workspace/inventory && cat src/inventory/stock.py src/inventory/report.py tests/test_stock.py tests/conftest.py && echo "=== grep threshold ===" && grep -rn "BULK\|discount\|or more" --include=*.py --include=*.md . | grep -v '\.gnomon/'

rm -rf /tmp/bitecheck && cp -r /workspace/inventory /tmp/bitecheck && cd /tmp/bitecheck && sed -i 's/qty >= BULK_THRESHOLD/qty > BULK_THRESHOLD/' src/inventory/pricing.py && grep -n 'BULK_THRESHOLD else' src/inventory/pricing.py && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -8; rm -rf /tmp/bitecheck
